title: Covered Manifest
description: Passwords typed at the dock shouldn't be readable over someone's shoulder. A quick pass over the login and register forms confirms the password fields actually mask input rather than just labeling themselves that way.
successCondition: On both /login and /register, the password input's type attribute is exactly "password" (not text, and not toggled visible by default), and each has the correct autoComplete value for its context — "current-password" on /login, "new-password" on /register.
hints: Read the DOM attribute directly rather than relying on the visual rendering, which a screenshot alone won't prove.
The two pages use different autoComplete values on purpose — don't copy one assertion onto both pages.
